name: Paint
brief: Base class for all drawable objects
signature: export abstract class Paint extends WasmObject

members.name: registerType
members.signature: static registerType(type: number, factory: PaintFactory): void
members.brief: Register a subclass factory for a given Tvg_Type value. Called by each subclass at module load time. @internal

members.name: id
members.brief: The ID of this paint object. IDs are used to identify paint objects within a picture's scene tree. Assign a string to generate a hash ID from the name, or a number to set directly.

members.name: rotate
members.brief: Rotate the paint by angle (in degrees)

members.name: origin
members.brief: Set the origin point for transformations (rotation, scale). The origin is specified as normalized coordinates (0.0 to 1.0). - (0, 0) = top-left corner - (0.5, 0.5) = center (default) - (1, 1) = bottom-right corner
members.returns: The Paint instance for method chaining

members.name: blend
members.brief: Set the blending method for this paint. Blending determines how this paint is combined with the content below it.
members.returns: The Paint instance for method chaining

members.name: opacity
members.brief: Get or set the opacity (0 to 255)

params.name: value
params.description: The opacity value in the range [0 ~ 255], where 0 is completely transparent and 255 is opaque.

members.returns: When setting, returns the Paint instance for method chaining. When getting, returns the opacity value (0-255).

members.name: bounds
members.brief: Get the axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) of this paint

members.name: bounds
members.brief: Get the oriented bounding box (OBB) of this paint as 4 corner points

members.name: bounds
members.brief: Get the bounding box of this paint

params.name: options
params.description: Optional options object with oriented flag

members.returns: AABB (Bounds) by default, or OBB (Point[]) if oriented is true

members.name: transform
members.brief: Applies a custom transformation matrix to the paint.
description: This method allows you to apply complex transformations that combine translation, rotation, scaling, and skewing in a single operation. The matrix is multiplied with any existing transformations.
members.returns: The Paint instance for method chaining

members.name: clip
members.brief: Sets a clipping path for this paint object.
description: The clipping path restricts the area where the paint will be rendered. Only the parts of the paint that overlap with the clipper shape will be visible.

params.name: clipper
params.description: A Paint object (typically a Shape) to use as the clipping path

members.returns: The Paint instance for method chaining

members.name: mask
members.brief: Sets a masking target object and the masking method.
description: The masking restricts the transparency of the source paint using the target paint.

params.name: target
params.description: A Paint object to use as the masking target

params.name: method
params.description: The method used to mask the source object with the target

members.returns: The Paint instance for method chaining

members.name: intersects
members.signature: intersects( x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number, visibleOnly: boolean = false ): boolean
members.brief: Checks whether the given rectangular region intersects the filled area of the paint.
description: Useful for hit-testing, such as detecting whether a click or touch landed on a painted region. The paint must have been updated by a Canvas beforehand — typically after the canvas has been drawn and synchronized.

params.name: x
params.description: The x-coordinate of the region's top-left corner

params.name: y
params.description: The y-coordinate of the region's top-left corner

params.name: width
params.description: The width of the region. Must be greater than 0

params.name: height
params.description: The height of the region. Must be greater than 0

params.name: visibleOnly
params.description: If true, hidden paints are excluded from the test (default: false)

members.returns: true if any part of the region intersects the filled area, false otherwise

members.name: fromPtr
members.brief: Create a correctly-typed Paint subclass from a raw WASM pointer. The returned object does NOT own the pointer (won't be freed by GC).
members.returns: Shape, Scene, Picture, or Text instance @internal
